image.name: mame
image.description: [MAME](https://www.mamedev.org/) is a free and open-source emulator designed to emulate the hardware of arcade games, video game consoles, old computers and other systems in software on modern personal computers.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings
MAME directory containing artwork, roms, and assets.

ports.desc: HTTP MAME desktop gui, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for MAME to function.

image.title: Mame
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  mame:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mame:latest
    container_name: mame
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
      - /path/to/mame/assets:/mame:ro
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=mame \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/mame/assets:/mame:ro \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mame:latest
